# Gardening Know How

> > Comprehensive gardening resource offering expert-written guides, plant care advice, and seasonal tips for ornamental gardens, edible gardens, houseplants, and outdoor landscapes.

Founded by gardening experts including Mary Ellen Ellis, Teo Spengler, and other horticulturists, Gardening Know How provides practical advice for both beginner and experienced gardeners. The site features a searchable plant database, monthly gardening calendars, and step-by-step tutorials covering everything from seed starting to composting.

## Key Topics

- Beginner gardening guides
- Plant care and troubleshooting
- Seed starting and propagation
- Perennials and ornamental plants
- Houseplants and indoor gardening
- Pruning techniques
- Composting methods
- Spring and seasonal planting
- Garden design and layout
- Organic gardening practices
- Seed germination techniques
- Tree care and maintenance
- Vegetable spacing and planning
- Plant division and propagation
- Climate-resilient gardening

## Getting Started

- [About Gardening Know How: Who We Are & What We Do](https://gardeningknowhow.com/about-us): About page with company info, team, and Q&A community details
- [Gardening For Beginners – Starting A Garden At Home The First Time](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/info/beginners-guide-to-gardening.htm): Essential beginner's guide for starting your first home garden
- [Houseplants For Beginners – General Houseplant Care And Growing Tips](https://gardeningknowhow.com/houseplants/hpgen/beginners-guide-to-houseplants.htm): Beginner's guide to indoor plant care and growing tips for newbies
- [Planting Seeds Made Easy: A Complete Guide To Seed Starting](https://gardeningknowhow.com/featuring/seed-starting-for-beginners-everything-to-know-before-you-start-seeds): Complete seed starting guide covering germination and seedling care

## Main Garden Categories

- [Gardening How To](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to): Main how-to section with propagation, zone guides, and techniques
- [Ornamental Gardens](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental): Main ornamental gardens section covering flowers, shrubs, and bulbs
- [Edible Gardens](https://gardeningknowhow.com/edible): Main edible gardens section for vegetables, fruits, and herbs
- [Houseplants](https://gardeningknowhow.com/houseplants): Houseplants hub featuring Monstera, Aloe Vera, and Spider Plants care
- [Trees](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/trees): Tree care section covering Maple, Oak, Magnolia, and ornamental trees
- [Flowers](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/flowers): Flower gardening section with design and care guides for blooms

## Seed Starting & Propagation

- [How To Nick Seeds Before Planting To Boost Germination](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/propagation/seeds/nicking-plant-seeds.htm): Seed scarification technique to improve germination of hard-coated seeds
- [Germinating Seeds In Paper Towel: Fast, Easy, No-Mess Sowing](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/seeds/germinating-seeds-in-paper-towel): Paper towel germination method for quick, no-mess seed starting
- [Divide These 9 Perennials in March for More Free Plants](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/propagation/best-perennials-to-divide-in-march): Plant division guide for March with propagation techniques

## Seasonal Gardening & Pruning

- [The March Edition: What to Plant, Prune & Do This Month](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/the-march-edition): Monthly garden calendar covering March planting and pruning tasks
- [12 Pruning Mistakes to Avoid if You're a Beginner Gardener](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/info/pruning-mistakes-to-avoid): Common spring pruning mistakes and techniques for beginner gardeners
- [4 Easy Pruning Tricks In March | Double Your Summer Blooms](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/easy-pruning-tricks-in-march-to-double-summer-blooms): Expert pruning techniques including heading back and hard pruning
- [8 Forgiving Perennials to Plant in March for Summer Color](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/forgiving-perennials-to-plant-in-march): Guide to planting hardy perennials like Geums, Astrantia, and Rudbeckia
- [6 Fast-Growing Flowers That Only Take 2 Months to Bloom](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/flowers/fast-growing-flowers-to-start-in-spring-for-blooms-in-2-months): Quick-blooming annual flowers for spring planting and May blooms
- [Why Winterizing Raised Beds Is Critical – And How To Do It](https://gardeningknowhow.com/garden-how-to/lideas/winterizing-raised-beds): Raised bed winter prep guide for soil conditioning and protection

## Composting & Soil Health

- [Hot Composting Guide: The Faster Way To Make Organic Compost](https://gardeningknowhow.com/composting/hot-composting): Hot composting method for faster organic compost production

## Plant Care & Troubleshooting

- [Poinsettia Care: Water, Light, and Keeping It Alive](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/flowers/poinsettia/poinsettia-care-how-do-you-take-care-of-poinsettias.htm): Comprehensive poinsettia care guide for watering, light, and maintenance
- [Growing Orchids In Water: An Easy Step-By-Step Guide](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/flowers/orchids/growing-orchids-in-water.htm): Water culture orchid growing guide with fertilizing instructions
- [Growing Herbs Indoors: How To Grow Herbs Indoors](https://gardeningknowhow.com/edible/herbs/hgen/growing-herbs-indoors.htm): Indoor herb gardening guide for growing herbs at home
- [Rosemary Turning Brown | 7 Key Issues and Easy Fixes](https://gardeningknowhow.com/edible/herbs/rosemary/brown-rosemary-plants.htm): Rosemary troubleshooting guide for diagnosing brown leaves and fixes
- [Growing Tips And Care Of Redbud Trees](https://gardeningknowhow.com/ornamental/trees/redbud/caring-for-redbud-trees.htm): Redbud tree care guide covering pruning, irrigation, and cultivation
- [Get Rid of Mealybugs Indoors | Organic Controls for Plants](https://gardeningknowhow.com/plant-problems/pests/insects/mealybugs-control.htm): Organic mealybug control using neem oil and insecticidal soap
- [5 Expert-Approved Ways To Protect Your Garden Against Flooding](https://gardeningknowhow.com/plant-problems/environmental/ways-to-protect-your-garden-against-flooding): Climate-resilient flood protection with no-till and water management
